tool.name: semantic_slice_triage
tool.description: Optional System One (non-generative) accelerator for de-rhetoricized Capability Primitives compilation over pure semantic files (.md/.markdown/.txt/.rst). Complements the primary read_file/grep workflow on large progressive doc trees (>= 6 docs totaling >= 20k bytes) or oversized docs (> 24k bytes). Avoid double-scanning files you already read (pass target="references" or a specific path). After triage, inspect Tier A line windows and any unscanned_slices via read_file; trust clean Tier B files without re-reading them one by one when unscanned_count=0.

parameters.parameter: Relative file path, directory (e.g. "rules", "references"), or "." for all semantic files. Defaults to ".".
"coarse" (default: ~4k packed chunks + auto zoom-in on gray-zone signals), "standard" (~1.2k chunks), or "fine" (~600 chunks).
Optional 1-based start line filter (default 0 = full file).
Optional 1-based end line filter (default 0 = full file).
